description_en: Queries the basic information of a specific thread under a specified DataAgent, including the title, status, associated Simple Log Service resources, version number, and time
description_zh: 查询指定 DataAgent 下某个会话的基本信息，包括标题、状态、关联的日志服务资源、版本号与时间
kebab_example: aliyun sls get-thread --name order-analysis-agent --thread-id thread-tiirv9-irwdoal8t4rm --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetThread

parameters.help_en: The name of the DataAgent. It is passed in the request path to specify the DataAgent to which the thread belongs
parameters.help_zh: DataAgent 的名称，通过请求路径传入，用于指定会话所属的 DataAgent
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the thread to query. It is passed in the request path and returned by CreateThread
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的会话 ID，通过请求路径传入，由 CreateThread 返回
parameters.name: thread_id

schema.description_en: The response body, which returns the basic information of the thread
schema.description_zh: 响应体。返回该会话的基本信息

additionalProperties.description_en: The attribute value of the string type

attributes.description_en: The custom attributes of the thread. Both keys and values are strings. The attributes are passed through CreateThread when the thread is created
attributes.description_zh: 会话的自定义属性，键与值均为字符串；创建会话时通过 CreateThread 传入

createTime.description_en: The creation time of the thread in ISO 8601 format with a time zone
createTime.description_zh: 会话的创建时间，采用带时区的 ISO 8601 格式

requestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate the call during troubleshooting
requestId.description_zh: 本次请求的 ID，用于问题排查时定位本次调用

status.description_en:
The status of the thread. Valid values:
active: The conversation can continue.
archived: The thread is archived.
suspended: The thread is suspended and waiting for additional input.
failed: The execution failed.
cancelled: The thread is cancelled
status.description_zh: 会话状态。常见取值：active（可继续对话）、archived（已归档）、suspended（已暂停，等待补充输入）、failed（执行失败）、cancelled（已取消）

title.description_en: The title of the thread. It is generated by the service based on the conversation content and can be modified by calling UpdateThread
title.description_zh: 会话标题，由服务根据对话内容生成，可通过 UpdateThread 修改

updateTime.description_en: The time when the thread was last updated. The format is the same as that of createTime
updateTime.description_zh: 会话最近一次更新的时间，格式同 createTime

variables.description_en: The context variables of the thread

project.description_en: The name of the Simple Log Service project associated with the thread
project.description_zh: 会话关联的日志服务 Project 名称

workspace.description_en: The name of the workspace associated with the thread
workspace.description_zh: 会话关联的工作空间（Workspace）名称

version.description_en: The version number of the thread, which is used to identify the sequence of modifications to the thread
version.description_zh: 会话的版本号，用于标识会话被修改的先后次序

v1_parameters.help_en: The name of the DataAgent. It is passed in the request path to specify the DataAgent to which the thread belongs
v1_parameters.help_zh: DataAgent 的名称，通过请求路径传入，用于指定会话所属的 DataAgent
v1_parameters.name: name

v1_parameters.help_en: The ID of the thread to query. It is passed in the request path and returned by CreateThread
v1_parameters.help_zh: 要查询的会话 ID，通过请求路径传入，由 CreateThread 返回
v1_parameters.name: threadId
